purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It performs aggregation and tabulation processing for national health insurance and general insurance monthly billing statements (総括表集計処理 - sōkatsuhyō shūkei shori). It reads claim/receipt data, accumulates totals by insurance category, and produces printed summary reports.

The program is clearly production-grade medical billing software from the JMA ORCA project, with a detailed multi-year revision history.
